placeholder-api:
About Placeholder API

It's a small, JIJ-able API that allows creation and parsing placeholders within strings and Minecraft Text Components.
Placeholder API uses a simple format of %modid:type% or %modid:type data% ( %modid:type/data% prior to 1.19).
It also includes simple, general usage text format indented for simplifying user input in configs/chats/etc.

 For users

It allows users to configure multiple mods in similar way without losing compatibility between mods.
Placeholders allow changing what and where any information is present within compatible mods.

Additionally, Simplified Text Format allows to style them in readable way without the requirement of writing JSON manually or using
generators.

- QuickText

This mod adds the Botany Pot which is a block that can grow all kinds of crops. The Botany Pot can be used for decoration, and to also make farming certain types of crops much easier. This mod was inspired by Davenonymous's awesome Bonsai Trees mod. 

 Features 
 
 Harvesting a crop in a Botany Pot will automatically replant the seed. 
 Hopper Botany Pot upgrade allows the pot to harvest itself and put items in a chest or other block with an inventory. 
 Seventeen different colors! 
 Extensive datapack support for adding new crops, soils, and fertilizers.

Introduction

NoPackCompatCheck disables the resource pack compatibility warnings on Resource Pack selection screen, making the display cleaner.

After installing this mod, Minecraft will no longer display resource pack version incompatibility warnings🤗.

 

 Why did I make this mod?

Since Minecraft 1.20, Mojang has begun frequently updating the resource pack format version. From Minecraft 1.6.1 to 1.19.4, the format version only increased from 1 to 13 , but by 1.21.8, it had already jumped to 64 🤣🤣🤣. This rapid “version number update” has left many resource packs without timely updates to the pack.mcmeta file’s declared supported versions, even though they are in fact compatible with newer versions of Minecraft. As a result, players often face an entire page of “incompatible” warnings on the resource pack screen.

 before install this mod

unloaded-activity:
What does this mod do?
In Minecraft, when you go far away from chunks, they'll stop being simulated. Later when you return, stuff like crops will not have grown at all, baby animals will still be babies, and the items you were cooking will still be cooking.

This mod changes that by simulating blocks and entities once they get within simulation distance to catch up after being unloaded for a period of time. It'll be as if they've always been simulated!

This also works when you're skipping the night. Instead of waiting for your iron to cook, or for your crops to grow, you can skip the night to speed up the process!

 How exactly does it work?
Every time a chunk, entity, or block entity gets ticked, it will save the current time, and also check how long it's been since it was last ticked. If the difference is large enough, my mod will start simulating it to make it catch up.

Do you ever find it odd that when you use Self-Destruct, Explosion or Misty Explosion there is no actual explosion? This mod is designed to correct this frustrating omission.

With this Cobblemon side-mod, every time any Pokémon uses an explosive move in battle, an actual explosion will occur. How does it work? Overview

Have you ever noticed how noisy Minecraft looks in the distance when using a high-resolution resource pack?The reason is that by default, Minecraft only supports full mipmaps for 16x16 textures and below. 

Anything higher than that will have incomplete mipmaps.
This mod fixes this by increasing the maximum level of mipmaps to 10 (1024x1024).

The optimal mipmap level depends on the resolution of your resource pack and can be found in the table below:
 Texture Resolution Optimal Mipmap Level 
 -------------------- ---------------------- 
 1 0 
 2 1 
 4 2 
 8 3 
 16 4 
 32 5 
 64 6 
 128 7 
 256 8 
 512 9 

 Technical Details

The problem with generating a full mipmap pyramids for Minecraft textures is that Minecraft combines all block textures into one big texture atlas. The maximum mipmap level of this atlas is a smallest maximum mipmap level of any individual texture.

Summary
This mod introduces a new attribute called food max. The attribute determines how much food and saturation can a player currently have.
By default, the maximum food capacity is increased to 40. This means a player has twice the food capacity as a vanilla player. Yes, this means you can finally eat more food than ever. 

This mod has custom rendering when your food level rises above 20. The colors are also configurable.

The mod has configurations. Go to .minecraft/config and find the mod's config file to edit it.

load-my-chunks:
LoadMyChunks 

 

 Load My Chunks is a standalone server-safe chunk loader mod that reduces server lag by refusing to load laggy chunks
 
 Functionality
Block Entity and Entity ticking is now executed chunk-wise rather than dimension wise. Chunks time their tick duration only if necessary.

Chunks are forceloaded only if they contain at least one chunk loader. If the chunk tick duration exceeds the server side maximum, then the chunk will cease being forceloaded and enter a dormant state for some time.

Dormant forced chunks will awaken once more at the end of the dormant period and enter a brief grace period where they are immune from tick duration checks, this is done to give multiblock structures a chance to reinitialize (I.E. Mekanism multiblocks which have an initial overhead on chunk load).

Chunk loaders work with or without the player being online.

 Utility Items
Advanced Inform

加载我的方块 Load My Chunks是一个独立的服务器安全的方块加载器模组，它通过拒绝加载滞后的方块来减少服务器滞后 功能 方块实体和实体刻度现在是按方块而不是按维执行的。只有在必要时，方块才会计时其刻度持续时间。 只有当区方块至少包含一个区方块载入程式时，才会胁迫载入区方块。如果区方块节拍持续时间超过服务器端的最大值，则区方块会停止胁迫载入，并进入休眠状态一段时间。 休眠的强制方块将在休眠期结束时再次唤醒，并进入一个短暂的宽限期，在该宽限期内，它们不受滴答持续时间检查的影响，这样做是为了给多方块结构一个重新初始化的机会（即Mekanism多方块，在方块加载时具有初始开销）。 无论玩家是否在线，区方块加载器都可以工作。 公用设施项目 高级通知

Original mod - Cave Dust by LizIsTired

 

 What is different from the original?

Cave Dust Rethinking keeps the atmosphere and core dust-generation behavior of the original mod while improving performance and reliability.

- Dust no longer appears inside solid blocks or fluids.
- The default particle density has been rebalanced from 25 to 14, keeping caves visibly dusty with a smaller FPS impact.
- Particle processing has been optimized to reduce unnecessary calculations.
- Configuration values are checked to prevent invalid settings from causing problems.
- Compatible with particle optimization mods such as AsyncParticles, Smart Particles, and Particle Core.
- Support has been added for newer Minecraft versions and additional mod loaders.

The particle density can still be adjusted in the configuration if you prefer more or less dust.

jump-tilt:
- Mod for fabric 1.20.1+ which brings back the jump tilt from before 1.14 Pre-release 2 (https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-225335)
- It also fixes an issue with jump tilt, which probably motivated its removal - tilting doesn't go past 90° and -90° - that means that when you fall and look straight down, tilting disables itself (adjustable with the config file).

 Config file
- Speed: "smoothness" of the tilting (can be set to 0 or more)
- Amount: "aggressivity" of the tilting (how far up and down the camera will tilt) (can be set to any value)
- Lower and upper clamp: after how many degrees of tilting (+/- 90°) the new values from clamping breaks replace the amount
- Clamping breaks: the value with which the amount is going to be replaced after tilting passes the lower or upper clamp (0 means that the tilting will be hard stopped after the clamp)

Unlimited Stacks

 Vanilla caps item stacks at 99. This mod raises that to 1,073,741,823. 

No config. No commands. No GUI. Install it and forget about it.

---

 The Problem With Vanilla

Minecraft enforces the stack limit in three separate places. Most mods that claim to remove the cap only fix one or two of them, which means stacks above 99 either:

Unofficial add-on — not affiliated with or endorsed by the Sodium team.
Sodium's video settings only let you set a maximum framerate in increments of 10 (140, 150, 160...), which makes it impossible to match your monitor's actual refresh rate if it isn't a multiple of ten — for example, a 144Hz or 165Hz display.

Dimension Follow

A Minecraft mod that makes you follow a player that gets teleported to another dimension.

This mod is very useful for mods like wonderland.jar where your friend gets teleported to another dimension but you get left behind.

 
 
 

 Modrinth page
 Curseforge page

 Config
The mod let's you configure basically every part of the mod. You can use the /dimensionfollow config command to change the config at any time without restarting the server.
 Radius
 /dimensionfollow config radius 

Players within this many blocks of the teleporting player's old position will follow them to the new dimension.
 Teleport Whole World
 /dimensionfollow config teleportWholeWorld 

If true, every player in the teleporting player's old dimension follows instead of only players inside radius.
 Require Confirmation

The bottom half and the top half can use different materials (for example brick on top and smooth stone on the bottom), so you get a true mixed double slab in one block space instead of being limited to two halves of the same slab.

limitedmace:
Limited Mace

A simple Fabric mod that allows only one Mace to be crafted per world. 
Once a player crafts the first Mace, all further crafting attempts (including automated crafters) are blocked.

 Features
- Prevents mass-crafting with shift-click.
- Compatible with automated crafters.
- /limitedmace reset command to allow crafting a new Mace.
- /limitedmace state command to check if the first Mace has been crafted.

 Usage
1. Install Fabric API for Minecraft 1.21.8.
2. Place the mod .jar file into your server's mods/ folder.
4. The first Mace crafted in the world will be allowed — all others are blocked until reset with command.

 Credits
I did not invent the Mace concept — it is an official Minecraft item by Mojang. This mod simply enforces a "one per world" rule, like other plugins do, using the Fabric modding API.

The "Custom Clear Lag" mod works in the background on your server. Here are the key steps:

 ⏱️ time : After how many minutes the cleanup should be performed (default is 5 minutes ).

cursed-fate-custom-open-domain-compatibi:
Makes open domains built with Voidcrawler's public custom open domain template register with Cursed Fate's normal open domain checks.

Without this, those domains can still run their own visuals and effects, but Cursed Fate does not see them as real open domains. That means nearby base domains may ignore them, and closed domains can be opened inside them.

With this installed serverside, the template's CustomOpenDomain data is picked up by Cursed Fate's open domain detection, so template-based domains can block nearby base domain expansions the same way the base mod's open domains do.

If you use a different template and still want to use this mod, make sure it uses the same CustomOpenDomain tag and it will register automatically.

Works automatically for any addons using the template, which can be found in the Cursed Fate Addon Hub Discord's addon-guide channel.

A kind of partial KeepInventory based on spawn points.

When you set your spawn, your inventory will be saved at that instant. When you die, only the items you had for that save will be restored. All your other items will drop at your death location.

For example, if you set your spawn before looting a structure and then die, you will keep the equipment you had before going into the structure, but the loot you collected while inside will drop.

 

 More Details 

- Works with beds and respawn anchors, and should work with most modded respawn systems
- You may click the respawn point again to save your inventory again
- Partial stacks are preserved, so if you save with 10 diamonds, collect 10 more diamonds, and then die, you will keep 10 diamonds and drop 10 diamonds
- Contents of bundles & shulker boxes are handled, for example if you save your inventory then put some items inside a bund

📖About Metal Works
Metal Works is a vanilla-styled mod that introduces three unique metals — Tin, Bronze, and Rose Gold — each with its own purpose and balance, ensuring no material is strictly superior to another. Tin is a lightweight, fast-swinging metal found deep where stone meets deepslate, used for armor, tools, and detailed decorative blocks like grates and lanterns. Bronze, an alloy of tin and copper, bridges the gap between iron and diamond, offering improved durability and natural fire resistance while also featuring decorative block variants. Rose Gold, crafted from gold and copper, matches iron’s strength but surpasses it in efficiency, enchantability, and longevity. You can also use Rose Gold to create a Mage Golem, which uses nearby enchanting power power to block monsters from spawning. Each metal supports different playstyles, encouraging variety in tools and builds rath

tidybinds:
📌 about
 Tidy Binds is a highly configurable utility primarily designed for modpack developers. It allows you to easily clean up the mess and clutter in the controls menu, as well as better integrate keybinds from mods into the game.

 🛠️ features
- key overrides: Redefine default keybinds so that pressing Reset restores your preferred defaults.
- key combinations: Trigger multiple actions with a single key by linking them together.
- category management: Move any keybind into a different category, including custom ones you define yourself.
- category ordering: Control exactly where each category appears in the list by assigning custom sort indices.
- key hiding: Hide unwanted keybinds to reduce clutter.
- key unbinding: Unbind hidden keys to prevent them from conflicting with existing ones.
- entry spacing: Add pixel padding between list entries for a cleaner look.

Singleplayer Jitter Fix: True Singleplayer Entity Animations

 
       
 

 
     
 

Ever since beta 1.3 the game has been PLAGUED by this very controlversion change: The client- serveer split.

If you dont know even on singleplayer your client runs a internal SERVER!

This causes a slew of desyncs and jittery behavior that is completley avoidable in single player.

This mod is simple in scope and simply addresses this issue with a series of targeted chanfes that fix all known smoothness issues.

Overview
Sable Assembly Fix fixes an item duplication bug that occurs during Sable assembly/disassembly for block entities that do not implement the Clearable interface.

 The Problem
Sable's SubLevelAssemblyHelper.moveBlocks() calls Clearable.tryClear() on every block entity during the assembly process. The issue is:

- For block entities that implement Clearable (e.g. chests, hoppers) — works fine, contents are properly cleared
- For block entities that do NOT implement Clearable (e.g. TableCloth, Mechanical Arm, Ejector, etc.) — tryClear() is a no-op, nothing happens
- The block is destroyed and its items drop into the world, but the NBT data containing the item inventory is still there
- When the block is recreated in the sub-level, the NBT items are read back
- Result: the same items exist both on the ground and inside the block — item duplication
 Triggering this bug is trivially c

noenchantlimits:
No Enchant Limits

Vanilla sorts enchantments into exclusive groups. Protection, Blast Protection, Fire Protection and Projectile Protection all fight over the same chestplate — pick one and the other three are gone. Sharpness, Smite and Bane of Arthropods do the same to a sword.

 This mod removes those groups. Any enchantment sits next to any other, everywhere it matters: the enchanting table, the anvil, and enchanted books. 

So one chestplate carries all four Protections. One sword carries Sharpness V, Smite V and Bane of Arthropods V at the same time.

 The anvil

There is a second wall vanilla puts in the way, and you hit it whether you like it or not: anvil cost doubles with every operation. Stacking six or seven enchantments onto one item runs into the 40-level Too Expensive! limit well before you are finished — which is exactly the point where this mod starts being worth having.

Terrain Addon for WorldEdit
Adds a single powerful command to WorldEdit that lets you generate realistic noise-based terrain inside any WorldEdit selection.
Usage
//terrain 
Noise Types

- perlin — Natural, smooth hills
- simplex — Similar to perlin, slightly smoother
- ridge — Sharp mountain ridges
- cellular — Cracked/rocky voronoi look
- flat — Flat fill with no variation

 Parameters

- height — Max height variation in blocks (1-256)
- scale — Feature width, higher = smoother/wider (0.1-500)
- octaves — Detail layers, higher = more complex (1-8)
- roughness — How jagged each octave is (0.1-1.0)
- block — Any WorldEdit block (e.g. grass block, stone)
- 
 Example
//terrain perlin 40 30 4 0.5 grass block
Requirements

 WorldEdit (required)
Fabric API (required)

Edgerunner

 Edgerunner brings back the feature of
 receiving effects according to the block right below the player's feet instead of the actual block the player is standing on, 
which was reported in MC-1133 
and fixed in 23w18a .

you can't eliminate the effects provided by soul sand, magma blocks, slime blocks,
honey blocks, ice, etc. by standing on the edge of the blocks anymore.

/gamerule edgerunner false

- Firework boosts disabled during rain.

 Server-Side Control 

- All effects configurable via server game rules.
- Fully vanilla-compliant using Minecraft’s ItemCooldowns system.

 Game Rules

- doElytraNerf – Global toggle for all elytra nerfs (default: true)
- disableElytraInRain – Disables elytra in rain (default: true)

Personal Borders 
Fabric mod that adds player-specific world borders using LuckPerms permissions. 
 

 Features
- Separate world borders for each player and each dimension
- Prevent players, players' projectiles, and players' pets from crossing the border
- Updated in real-time when permissions are changed

 Configuration
Personal Borders looks for next four permission nodes in LuckPerms:
- personal-borders : default world border, if dimension-specific border is not set
- personal-borders.overworld : overworld border
- personal-borders.the nether : nether border
- personal-borders.the end : end border

Parameters of the border are stored in the permission node as context values that are similar to Vanilla world border command:
- center.x , center.z : coordinates of the border center
- distance : size of the border (diameter)
- warning.distance : distance from the border at which the play

 Features
- Shared HTTP server (Java HTTP) for all mods, start/stop in common code.
- Simple API for routes: get/post/registerRoute with mod namespace ( /modid/... ).
- Static file serving per mod ( serveStatic with safe path handling).
- Built-in health/info/route listing: /tango-webapi/health , /tango-webapi/info , /tango-webapi/routes .
- Configuration via file ( config/tango-webapi.properties ) or env/system props.
- Error pages (404/405/503) with simple HTML templates.

 Configuration
File: config/tango-webapi.properties 
 properties
host=0.0.0.0
port=8080
maxRequestBytes=1000000

 Features

 Hide Hotbar: Completely removes the hotbar (item slots) from the screen.

 Indication: When hidden, a neat text notification "HUD hidden" appears in the center of the screen. (For a few seconds)

 Unhides hotbar on damage (disabled by default)

 None!

When a single attack is already enough to decide the outcome, this mod automatically fills in the small remaining difference, delivering a cleaner and smoother combat experience.

 Design Goals

Have you ever charged up a powerful attack for ages, only to see the enemy left with a tiny sliver of health?

Or lost the fight because a boss survived with just a bit of HP and turned the tables?

This mod exists exactly for those moments!

It evaluates the final damage result. If the damage dealt by the player is almost enough to kill a creature, the mod will make up the difference and finish the job.

Combat. Feels. Good.

 Mechanics

 Calculation Logic

 finalDamage : The final effective damage (after armor, enchantments, etc.)
 healthBefore : The target’s health before taking damage

 
IF
healthBefore finalDamage
AND
healthBefore - finalDamage 8 0.5 → False

SQLite, MySQL and Postgres are supported as data backends.

 Why this fork?

This mod was initially forked from MrNavaStar. His original mod can be found on 
github and modrinth.
Reasons for this fork are:

 At the time the project was forked, the database handling was messed up by using an all-in-one table for the player 
 data defined in SQLib
 At the time the project was forked, for each SQL call a database connection was established
 Having a separate upstream for production environment testing
 Details are list in issue 1

You can support MrNavaStar by buying him a coffee!.

 Installation

This mod requires Fabric and Fabric API .

This mod is available on modrinth with slug mr-i

bloomy-settings-import:
Introduction
Are you sick of needing to reset your settings everytime you make a new instance of minecraft? Bloomy Settings Import offers the solution! 
 What is Bloomy Settings Import
Bloomy Settings Import is a mod originally made for the Bloomy Modpack, but is also perfectly usable as a standalone mod! 
The mod adds a button in your settings where you can import and export your options.txt file. This little file has the information about what your keybinds are, your graphics settings, your mouse sensitivity, your sound settings, etc.

 

 How does it work
By copying your file paths you can easily make a directory where you want store your options.txt file, without ever leaving the game! In the same way, by copying a file path from anywhere on your computer you can easily import an options.txt file, restoring the settings you had previously configured.

 VerSion

In Minecraft Vanilla, there is no simple command (or any source, that is) providing the currently running Minecraft Version or data pack format to datapacks.

VerSion addresses this issue and may be used as an API by other datapacks to get the current pack format. Using overlays, VerSion achieves this goal in an inexpensive, light-weight and future-proof manner.

In contrast to existing alternatives (like Version Detector, which at least supports earlier versions), VerSion covers way more formats, does not throw faulty errors (when in reality, everything's working) or display excessive amounts of notices, and thus may be used elegantly and in any form of datapack project you plan to implement. Of course, it is free of charge and open-source forever.

 A lightweight stamina & fatigue system for Minecraft – Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1

 Tired of running endlessly, fighting for ages, and never getting tired? Simple Stamina fixes this by adding a stamina and fatigue system.

- Stamina bar – a new bar above hunger. It drains when you sprint, jump, attack, mine, or swim.

- Fatigue – a long‑term exhaustion that builds up when you skip sleep or overexert yourself.
- Sleep now restores 50% of your current fatigue (reduces it by half).
- Food restores a little stamina – the more saturation the food gives, the more stamina you recover.

 Features

 Reporting Issues

mciron:
Minecraft Iron makes the game harder by adding features such as stamina, hydration, heat and cold, nutrition, as well as tool and material progression. You'll start with sticks and rocks, you'll need to craft the Crafting Rock for your first tools. There are now Copper and Steel tools, and reaching Iron tier will be more of a proccess. There is also post Iron upgrades and post Netherite tiers. 

Iron can only be obtained through Create Iron Sheets or by upgrading Copper gear with an Iron Smithing Template.

Food spoils, animals have to be butchered, trees don't float, torches and campfires extinguish and go out, fire spreads kinda fast, mobs have solid hitboxes, zombies are scarier, when it's dark, it's DARK.

Difficulty and Progression mods include:

- Early Stage
- Progression Reborn
- TreeChop
- Dehydration
- Frostiful & Scorchful
- Burnt
- Butchery
- Nutrition
- Solid Mobs
- Hardcore

Withered Utils is a optimization modpack that doesn't change vanilla content and adds many useful tools.

26.1.2 alpha will be available soon.

It lets you play on any server thanks to ViaFabricPlus but beware of the servers rules, some of the mods features might be considered cheating.

 Performance
It includes the usual performance mods you can find on modrinth's first page but also less known ones like Better Block Entities.

On a gaming laptop with a Ryzen 5 7535HS and a RTX 3050 4GB it gets 300-350 FPS without shaders and 80 FPS with BSL at medium setting (16 chunks).
Nvidium 1.21.10 is from drouarb/nvidium. 

Also works on Mobile Launchers; a GalaxyA14 using MobileGlues with ANGLE as OpenGL ES Driver gets stable 60 FPS without shaders (8 chunks).

- Simple Armor Hud
- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's World Map
- Status Effects Bars 
- Leave My Bars Alone
- Appleskin
- MiniH

Potato Juice is an extremely good optimizer. It will bring your potato back from the dead. Got consistently over 150 fps with 8 chunk render and sim distance on 1080p resolution. Benchmarked on intel core i5 7360u dual core. I also tested it on an old laptop from 2013 with 4 Gb of ddr3 Ram. It got consistently over 70 fps. NOTE: There are github projects in development working to make sodium compatible with Vulkanmod. I will add them when they become available. Hopefully shader support will become available for Vulkanmod in the future, but I have no idea when that will be.

Survival Rebalanced attempts to fix or improve vanilla survival's miscellaneous shortcomings with several small and large tweaks that don't deviate too much from how vanilla survival already functions.

 
 

 A note about how I view survival mode
While I personally believe survival mode should be about surviving, I understand that many still primarily play for the sandbox the game provides. To appeal to both perspectives, I plan to only change the progression towards end-game gear. This means, for example, that I don't plan to nerf Elytra, but I will slow down enchanting by nerfing librarian villagers.

Zenzai Itacha Font

 Zenzai Itacha Font replaces Minecraft's default font with a punchy Japanese-style brush face with anime-title energy. Every character - letters, numbers, punctuation and symbols - has been redrawn from the real typeface at high resolution, so chat, menus, signs, books, item names and the debug screen all change style the moment you turn the pack on.

 Features

- Punchy anime-title brush strokes
- Bold and dramatic
- Made to headline
- High-resolution glyph sheet - crisp on any GUI scale
- Font only: no textures, models or sounds are touched, so it stacks on top of any other resource pack

 How to install

1. Download the .zip - do not unzip it.
2. In Minecraft, go to Options - Resource Packs - Open Pack Folder .
